title: Who approves what has changed
description: Every internal request now goes to the department's team leader and then the manager, and timesheets go straight to the manager. The CEO, business manager and admin no longer approve anything.
items: Leave: relievers, then the team leader, then the manager
Overtime, time corrections and reimbursements: the team leader, then the manager
A team leader's own request skips straight to the manager
The manager's own requests and timesheets are approved as soon as they are submitted
The manager now sees every department
